Examples.Title: Delete voice
Examples.Description: Deletes a voice and cancels any pending operations on it. Cannot be undone.
Examples.Code:
### Delete voice
# @name delete
DELETE {{host}}/v1/ai/voice/{{id}}
X-API-Key: {{api_key}}
lmnt-version: {{lmnt-version}}
Accept: application/json

## Responses
# 200
# Description: OK
# Content-Type: application/json
# 400
# Description: Bad Request
# Content-Type: application/json
# 401
# Description: Unauthorized
# Content-Type: application/json
# 402
# Description: Payment Required
# Content-Type: application/json
# 403
# Description: Forbidden
# Content-Type: application/json
# 404
# Description: Not Found
# Content-Type: application/json
# 429
# Description: Too Many Requests
# Content-Type: application/json
# 500
# Description: Internal Server Error
# Content-Type: application/json

Examples.Title: Update voice
Examples.Description: Updates metadata for a specific voice. Only provided fields will be changed.
Examples.Code:
### Update voice
# @name update
PUT {{host}}/v1/ai/voice/{{id}}
X-API-Key: {{api_key}}
lmnt-version: {{lmnt-version}}
Content-Type: application/json
Accept: application/json

{
  "description": "string",
  "gender": "string",
  "name": "string",
  "starred": true,
  "tags": [
    "string"
  ]
}
